newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech selects Ammirati Puris for ads.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech selects Ammirati Puris for ads.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Friday it named Ammirati Puris Lintas (APL) to handle its $100 million consumer, business and brand advertising accounts.

The telecommunications company said APL was selected after a two-week final phase of the review process, which culminated in two "excellent" presentations by APL and BBDO Worldwide, part of Omnicom Group Inc.
Ameritech said APL replaces three incumbent agencies, Leo Burnett Co, Fallon McElligott, and DDB Needham Worldwide, which is also part of Omnicom.
Ameritech said Leo Burnett will continue to handle media buying for the corporation and will work in tandem with APL.
APL will establish a full-service office in Chicago. In addition to acting as the lead office on behalf of Ameritech, it will pursue other opportunities in the Chicago market.
APL's selection concludes a process that began in March, Ameritech said. From a preliminary stage, the review moved on to include presentations from five finalists.
APL is one of the top 10 international agency networks, with 140 offices in 72 countries and 7,400 employees. Billings are currently reported at $6 billion.
